scenario.name: r-rc-2-threshold-accept
scenario.description: request_compaction() over-threshold ACCEPT (compaction FIRES). Triggers an agent turn via sessions.send that calls request_compaction on a DEDICATED >=70%-context session; asserts ACCEPT + a compaction/summarization lifecycle event (the reclaim). requires-human-confirmation: compaction is irreversible-in-session. Uses sessions.send agent-turn dispatch (#134), dedicated session (never live main).

invocation.reasonTemplate: R-RC-2 proof nonce {{nonce}}: over-threshold accept probe (compaction expected to fire on this dedicated session).

expectedReceipts.name: agent-turn-triggered
expectedReceipts.description: sessions.send accepted -> an agent turn fired that calls request_compaction (the #134 dispatch path)

expectedReceipts.name: request-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: request_compaction was ACCEPTED (>=70% context threshold met), not rejected

expectedReceipts.name: compaction-fired
expectedReceipts.description: A compaction/summarization lifecycle event fired on the dedicated session = context reclaimed (the ACCEPT proof)

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: Trace ID from the turn for Tempo fetch

review.notes: ACCEPT path (compaction FIRES) via sessions.send agent-turn dispatch. requires-human-confirmation: irreversible-in-session, runs ONLY on a DEDICATED >=70%-context session (the scenario hard-refuses sessionKey='main'). PASS-candidate when turn triggered + compaction fires; HONEST-LIMIT-candidate when turn fired but session below threshold (accept unreachable, not a guard bug). To exercise: prepare a dedicated high-context session OR lower the threshold via config + restart-to-arm. Run R-RC-1 (REJECT) first to prove the guard. candidateSha + seat resolved from env at runtime.
